support_caveats: Only platforms named in included_platforms are supplied by this package.
The Linux binary requires glibc 2.28 or newer.
Windows x86-64 Stata/MP 19 GUI supports eligible parallel input; Break during Windows loading may be delayed or unavailable.
Native Intel-host Stata testing is outstanding; the macOS plugin contains both processor slices.
The accepted Linux no-FE 16-regressor, one-worker slowdown of 7.3% versus beta.14 remains; see docs/VALIDATION.md.
performance_acceptance: Johannes accepted the exact-elimination workstream on 2026-11-08 and the fedemean plan and addenda on 2026-11-08 to 2026-11-10. The November revision campaign on 80b6768e (runtime identical to 44cd1563) is descriptive: median default fereg time 0.572 of beta.15 over 63 matching cells. Historical performance exceptions and failures remain recorded in docs/VALIDATION.md; no adverse results were resampled.
